title: σῴζει ἀπὸ Λύκου
learning_goal: Practice present-tense first/second person forms and imperatives with vocatives using ὦ, alongside simple third-person narration.
plot: Glaux and Panda play ball until Lukos threatens them; Hyperbrephos hears their call, rushes out, stops Lukos with a rock, and the friends play happily again.
